meta.what_this_is: Counts over SPELLING. The language has no official phonemic description; 'onset', 'coda' and 'syllable' are built by the fixed rules in the script's docstring.

rules.vowel_units: u'u, aa ei ey ii oo uu, au ae, and vowel+h (ah eh ih oh uh) when the h ends the word or precedes a consonant ('ah' also before a vowel)
rules.consonant_units: th, sh, qu-before-vowel; every other consonant letter; y is a consonant except in ey
rules.ir_ur: counted as vowel + r; their status as runes is under rune_spelling
rules.syllabification: one nucleus per vowel unit; medial consonant runs split by maximal onset, where a licit onset is one that begins a lexicon word; a single consonant always opens the next syllable
rules.decomposable: cut into 2-4 other lexicon words of >= 3 letters, 'se' allowed between parts (string test)
rules.tiers: game_ref = at least one reference other than Prima, TIL, BN, DBgamedata on the dictionary row

caveats: Compounds dominate the longer words, so many medial clusters are junctures between words (sos-mir), not clusters inside a morpheme. Use lexicon_not_decomposable for morpheme-internal patterns.
ng is counted as n + g; whether it is one sound (viing) cannot be decided from spelling.
The maximal-onset rule cuts kendov as ken-dov and ahkrin as ah-krin; it knows nothing of morphemes.
Token statistics leave out names and misspellings as classed in corpus-oov.json.

found_only_in_words_absent_from_the_cano.note: Patterns carried only by dictionary spellings that never occur as a token in the canon corpus (the weakest-attested layer: mostly Prima-guide-only and Imperial-Library-only rows).

rune_spelling.basis: Non-duplicate corpus records whose spelling field is the wiki's rune-case (word walls and rune tables). The casing is the wiki editors' transcription of the in-game rune text; it has not been checked against the game.

affix_candidates.note: Pairs of spellings in which one is the other plus an ending (or beginning) and BOTH are in the word list. A string test only: many pairs are chance (in + hus, al + ok). Meaning must be checked by hand before a pair is called a derivation.

forge_profile.tiers: core: 5 or more words; marginal: 2 to 4; single: 1

wordlikeness_model.what: mean log2 P(unit | previous unit) over a word with boundaries, add-k smoothing
